title: Barry Sacramento · Interior 2.5D Fly-Through
provenance: Interior background and photographic people/shadow/fog assets are derived from the user-approved construction-corridor reference composition. The two men and their shadows are separate transparent layers; fog/haze are separate transition layers.

motion.effect: photographic 2.5D parallax fly-through / foreground fog occlusion / downward camera glide
motion.principle: continuous forward/downward camera travel; foreground fog fully occludes the lens before clearing downward; incoming interior is already moving underneath; nearer architecture clears faster than rear corridor; people and shadows remain independent depth planes
motion.masterTransition: foreground construction dust/fog rises across the lens, vertical whoosh smear hides the substitution, then the same occluder sweeps downward while the already-moving interior resolves
